A '''battle squadron''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]]. The battle squadron was centered on a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], with two [[attack line]]s and a [[pursuit line]] for an average of eighteen [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. In general terms, the three [[line]]s mattered little; it was the Star Destroyer that was the most important part of the squadron. Battle squadrons were deployed to suppress [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] or run down an enemy force. The deployment of a battle squadron showed that the Navy considered the mission to be one of utmost importance.

==History==
The [[2391st Battle Squadron]] fought against the [[Kalindan System Defense Force]] and the [[Kalindan Deep Space Fleet]] during the [[Battle of Kalinda]]. But was ultimately forced into retreat.
